# Tailscale MCP — LLM index

Full corpus: [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt)

## Summary
FastMCP 3.2+ Tailscale network controller. 24 MCP tools exposing the Tailscale Admin API
to AI assistants: devices, DNS, services, monitoring, Funnel, Taildrop, LM Link, and
SEP-1577 agentic workflows. Optional Vite/React webapp (port 10820/10821).

## Quick start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/tailscale-mcp
cd tailscale-mcp && uv sync
uv run tailscale-mcp
```
Requires `TAILSCALE_API_KEY` + `TAILSCALE_TAILNET`.

## Ports
| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Frontend (Vite) | 10820 |
| Backend/MCP HTTP | 10821 |
| Prometheus metrics | 9091 |

## MCP tools
| Tool | Domain |
|------|--------|
| `manage_tailnet_devices` | Device CRUD, approvals, posture |
| `manage_tailnet_network` | DNS, MagicDNS, routing, services |
| `monitor_tailnet` | Metrics, Prometheus, health |
| `manage_taildrop` | File send/receive |
| `manage_funnel` | Public exposure via Funnel |
| `run_tailnet_security` | ACLs, posture, device keys |
| `run_tailnet_automation` | Webhooks, tags, logging |
| `manage_tailnet_backups` | Configuration backup/restore |
| `get_lm_link` | LM Link (Tailscale + LM Studio remote LLMs) |
| `get_help` | Help & discovery |
| `get_tailnet_status` | Dashboard status |
| `run_agentic_tailnet_workflow` | SEP-1577 agentic workflows |

## LM Link (Tailscale + LM Studio, Feb 2026)
7 operations: `status` (peers+models), `enable`, `disable`, `set_device_name`,
`set_preferred_device`, `info`, `readiness`. Webapp `/lm-link` page is a live dashboard.

- `README.md` — full documentation
- `CHANGELOG.md` — version history
- `docs/TAILSCALE_MCP_PORTMANTEAU_TOOLS.md` — tool deep dive
